subtitle: Under the Red Earth, a Silent City Writes Its Name

panels.shot: epic bird's-eye over Vaigai river valley at dawn
panels.action: Mist hangs over the Vaigai River as the sun rises, revealing green fields above a hidden grid of buried brick streets and homes suggested as faint lines beneath the red earth.

dialogue.text: In the Vaigai valley near Madurai, the buried homes of Keezhadi’s urban families wait, as potsherds and bricks begin to speak of a Sangam-age city of letters.

i18n.hi: वैगई घाटी में मदुरै के पास, कीழड़ी के दबे शहरी घर इंतज़ार में हैं, जहाँ मिट्टी के टुकड़े और ईंटें सांगम युग के पढ़े-लिखे शहर की कहानी सुनाने लगे हैं

panels.shot: wide landscape establishing shot
panels.action: A quiet modern village landscape near Keezhadi shows ploughed fields, palm trees, and the Vaigai River winding in the distance under a hot, pale sky.

dialogue.text: Today, Keezhadi is a quiet village near the Vaigai. For centuries, no one guessed that brick walls and written pots slept beneath these fields.

i18n.hi: आज कीழड़ी, वैगई के किनारे बस एक शांत गाँव है। सदियों तक किसी को भनक भी नहीं थी कि इन खेतों के नीचे ईंट की दीवारें और लिखे घड़े सो रहे हैं

panels.shot: slow push-in on archaeologist’s survey trench from above
panels.action: An early survey trench cuts through layered soil, showing neat stratigraphy as a lone archaeologist silhouette studies the exposed profile with a measuring staff.

dialogue.text: In 2013–2014, an ASI survey along the Vaigai watched the soil itself. Among many mounds, Keezhadi’s earth answered with brick, pottery and a promise of a town.

i18n.hi: 2013–14 में एएसआई ने वैगई के किनारे मिट्टी को ही पढ़ा। कई टीलों में से कीழड़ी की धरती ने ईंट, मिट्टी के बर्तन और बसते शहर के वादे से जवाब दिया

panels.shot: medium shot from ground level across first ASI excavation squares
panels.action: Ordered squares marked with white string reveal emerging brick alignments and pottery flakes as workers patiently scrape the soil with trowels under shade cloth.

dialogue.text: From 2014, the Archaeological Survey of India sank careful squares. Brick structures appeared, laid in runs and right angles, not random rubble but planned spaces.

i18n.hi: 2014 से भारतीय पुरातत्व सर्वेक्षण ने नपे-तुले खाने खोदे। ईंट की सजल कतारें, सीधी दीवारें उभरीं — बेतरतीब मलबा नहीं, सोचा-समझा बसेरा

panels.shot: slow push-in on Keezhadi Urban Mother crouched by a brick wall in imagination overlay
panels.action: Over the excavated brick wall, a faint, ghostly Keezhadi Urban Mother in a simple sari crouches, her hand resting where a doorway once stood, looking toward an unseen courtyard.

dialogue.text: Beneath each line of brick, a family once lived. We do not know their names. Yet their walls show streets, rooms, and courtyards where a mother stepped out each morning.

i18n.hi: हर ईंट की लकीर के नीचे कभी एक परिवार था। नाम नहीं पता, पर उनकी दीवारें गलियाँ, कमरे, आंगन दिखाती हैं जहाँ हर सुबह एक माँ बाहर कदम रखती थी

panels.shot: wide interior reconstruction shot of house courtyard, low-angle
panels.action: A reconstructed scene shows Keezhadi Urban Mother in a brick-walled courtyard, children nearby, a hearth, storage jars and a dice on the ground, with an upper storey hinted above.

dialogue.text: Keezhadi’s houses had courtyards, storage jars, platforms and perhaps upper floors. Dice, ornaments and terracotta toys speak of work and play in a bustling town.

i18n.hi: कीழड़ी के घरों में आंगन, भंडार घड़े, चौबुतरे और शायद ऊपर की मंज़िलें थीं। पासों, गहनों और मिट्टी के खिलौनों से काम और खेल से भरा शहर झाँकता है

panels.shot: tight close-up on hand placing a small terracotta toy beside a child
panels.action: Keezhadi Urban Mother’s hand sets a small terracotta cattle figure before a seated child in the courtyard, with other household objects around them.

dialogue.text: Terracotta figurines and toys lie where children once played. They link Keezhadi to a wider Sangam world that sang of cities, markets, cattle and the dust of roads.

i18n.hi: जहाँ बच्चे खेलते थे, वहीं मिट्टी की मूर्तियाँ और खिलौने पड़े मिले। ये कीழड़ी को उस बड़े सांगम जगत से जोड़ते हैं जिसने शहरों, बाज़ारों, मवेशियों और धूल भरी सड़कों को गाया

panels.shot: macro shot of a potsherd emerging from soil
panels.action: Gloved fingers gently lift a curved potsherd half-revealed in the soil; faint Tamil Brahmi letters arc across its weathered surface.

dialogue.text: Among the broken pots was something new. On some sherds, scratched before firing, Tamil Brahmi letters appeared. Short names, words, marks of owners and makers.

i18n.hi: टूटे घड़ों के बीच कुछ नया था। कुछ टुकड़ों पर, पकने से पहले खरोंचकर तमिल ब्राह्मी अक्षर उभर आए — छोटे नाम, शब्द, मालिक और कारीगर के निशान

panels.shot: extreme close-up on an inscribed sherd, top-lit
panels.action: An inscribed potsherd lies on a dark cloth, its sharp letters clearly visible as a spotlight reveals the strokes of Tamil Brahmi script across the curve.

dialogue.text: Tamil Brahmi was known from caves and coins. Now, at Keezhadi, it sat on humble pots. This was not royal stone alone, but writing in everyday homes.

i18n.hi: तमिल ब्राह्मी पहले गुफाओं और सिक्कों पर जाना जाता था। अब कीழड़ी में वही आम घड़ों पर बैठा है — सिर्फ़ राजसी पत्थर नहीं, रोज़मर्रा के घरों की लिखावट

panels.shot: medium shot over a table of finds: dice, beads, iron tools, punch-marked coin
panels.action: On a cataloguing table stand a terracotta die, glass and stone beads, iron tools, and a small punch-marked coin beside tagged pottery fragments.

dialogue.text: Keezhadi yielded dice, beads, iron objects and punch-marked coins. Its families joined networks of trade that ran through the Vaigai, across the peninsula and beyond.

i18n.hi: कीழड़ी से पासे, मनके, लोहे की चीज़ें और पंच-चिह्नित सिक्के निकले। यहाँ के परिवार वैगई के रास्ते, पूरे प्रायद्वीप और आगे तक फैलते व्यापार जाल में जुड़े थे

panels.shot: bird's-eye of Vaigai valley with trade routes sketched as glowing lines
panels.action: Over the Vaigai valley landscape, faint glowing lines sketch imagined trade routes linking Keezhadi toward Madurai, coastal ports and northern roads.

dialogue.text: The finds fit the Sangam Age, when poems praised Madurai and other cities. Keezhadi seems one node in a broader urban cluster, not yet identified with any one famed capital.

i18n.hi: ये सारे मिले सामान सांगम युग में फिट बैठते हैं, जब कविताएँ मदुरै और दूसरे शहरों की तारीफ़ करती थीं। कीழड़ी शायद एक बड़े शहरी गुट का पड़ाव है, किसी मशहूर राजधानी से अभी सीधे नहीं जोड़ा गया

panels.shot: medium shot of stratigraphic section with labeled layers
panels.action: A clean vertical cut in the trench wall shows distinct soil layers, with small flags marking sample spots where charcoal and potsherds were removed.

dialogue.text: To know time, archaeologists turned to layers. Charred seeds and other samples from secure contexts went to labs, seeking dates for Keezhadi’s old floors and hearths.

i18n.hi: समय जानने को पुरातत्वविद परतों की तरफ़ मुड़े। जली बीज और ठोस परतों से लिए नमूने लैब गए, कीழड़ी के पुराने फ़र्श और चूल्हों की तारीखें खोजने

panels.shot: close-up of an AMS dating machine in a lab setting
panels.action: Inside a modern laboratory, a sleek AMS dating instrument stands amid cables and monitors, with a labeled sample vial poised before it.

dialogue.text: Accelerator Mass Spectrometry tests returned early dates for some layers, reaching toward the first millennium BCE. Yet the key question stayed: which layers held the written pots?

i18n.hi: एएमएस जाँच से कुछ परतों के लिए बहुत पुरानी तारीखें आईं, पहली सहस्त्राब्दी ईसा-पूर्व तक पहुँचती हुई। पर बड़ा सवाल बचा रहा — लिखे घड़े किस परत में हैं?

panels.shot: slow push-in on archaeologist examining notes and section drawings
panels.action: An archaeologist sits at a desk covered with trench diagrams and photographs, a magnifying glass over a drawing of the stratigraphy where an inscribed shard is marked.

dialogue.text: Dating depends on context. If a sherd shifts from its original layer, its letters cannot borrow that layer’s age. Keezhadi’s story must be built on secure associations, not hope.

i18n.hi: तारीख संदर्भ पर टिकी है। अगर कोई घड़ा अपने असली घर से खिसक जाए, तो उसके अक्षर उस परत की उम्र नहीं उधार ले सकते। कीழड़ी की कहानी मज़बूत जोड़ पर बनेगी, सिर्फ़ उम्मीद पर नहीं

panels.shot: wide shot of press conference room with projected site images
panels.action: A modern auditorium shows a speaker pointing to projected images of Keezhadi’s trench and calendar dates while journalists listen and take notes.

dialogue.text: As reports emerged, some voices rushed to say, ‘Literacy in Tamil by the sixth century BCE!’ The claim travelled fast, but many scholars urged caution.

i18n.hi: रिपोर्टें आते ही कुछ आवाज़ें दौड़ पड़ीं — ‘छठी सदी ईसा-पूर्व तक तमिल साक्षरता!’ दावा तेज़ी से फैला, पर कई विद्वानों ने सँभलकर देखने को कहा

panels.shot: tight close-up on a historian’s thoughtful face against shelves of books
panels.action: A historian sits before shelves of epigraphy volumes, brows knit, one hand resting on Iravatham Mahadevan’s book opened to Tamil Brahmi dating discussions.

dialogue.text: Iravatham Mahadevan and others had long placed Tamil Brahmi mostly between the 2nd century BCE and 3rd century CE. Keezhadi might push details, but evidence must be weighed with care.

i18n.hi: इरावथम महादेवन और दूसरे तमिल ब्राह्मी को ज़्यादातर दूसरी सदी ईसा-पूर्व से तीसरी सदी ईसा के बीच रखते आए थे। कीழड़ी तारीखें आगे खिसका सकती है, पर सबूत तौलकर ही मानने होंगे

panels.shot: medium shot of two groups of scholars in animated but restrained discussion
panels.action: Around a table, scholars gesture over maps and charts of Keezhadi; their discussion looks intense but civil, with notes and reports spread between them.

dialogue.text: Some argued that Keezhadi proved very early Tamil literacy and a long urban past. Others replied that until detailed layers, publications and peer review were complete, such sweeping claims were premature.

i18n.hi: कुछ ने कहा कीழड़ी से बहुत पुरानी तमिल साक्षरता और लंबा शहरी अतीत साबित होता है। दूसरे बोले, जब तक परतें, विस्तार से प्रकाशन और सहकर्मी समीक्षा पूरी न हों, इतने बड़े दावे जल्दबाज़ी हैं

panels.shot: wide shot of Keezhadi site under new sheds, TN archaeology team working
panels.action: Under protective sheds, Tamil Nadu State Department of Archaeology staff work methodically in fresh trenches, with labeled squares and careful storage of finds nearby.

dialogue.text: After the ASI seasons, Tamil Nadu’s archaeology department took up the spade. Through more campaigns, they mapped more walls, recovered more inscribed sherds, and prepared fuller reports.

i18n.hi: एएसआई की ऋतुओं के बाद तमिलनाडु पुरातत्व विभाग ने फावड़ा संभाला। और अभियानों से उन्होंने और दीवारें जोड़ीं, ज़्यादा लिखे टुकड़े निकाले, और भरी-पूरी रिपोर्टें तैयार कीं

panels.shot: interior wide shot of Keezhadi site museum opened in 2023
panels.action: Inside the Keezhadi museum, visitors gaze at lit displays of bricks, pots, dice and inscribed sherds arranged in glass cases along an airy hall.

dialogue.text: In 2023, a site museum opened. Now the town that lay unseen for nearly two thousand years stands in cases and reconstructions, its quiet objects facing a curious public.

i18n.hi: 2023 में साइट संग्रहालय खुला। अब जो शहर दो हज़ार साल तक ओझल था, वही अब शीशों और मॉडल में खड़ा है, उसके शांत अवशेष जिज्ञासु लोगों से रूबरू

panels.shot: slow push-in on Keezhadi Urban Mother’s imagined figure reflected in a museum glass case
panels.action: Keezhadi Urban Mother’s faint reflection appears on the glass of a display holding her era’s inscribed potsherds, her face calm and unreadable as visitors walk past behind.

dialogue.text: We still do not know her name. Yet her family’s broken pot, scratched with letters, sits under glass. Through it, an urban Tamil household steps into recorded history.

i18n.hi: हम आज भी उसका नाम नहीं जानते। लेकिन उसके परिवार का टूटा घड़ा, खरोंचे अक्षरों के साथ, शीशे के नीचे टिका है। उसके ज़रिए एक शहरी तमिल घर दर्ज इतिहास में कदम रखता है

panels.shot: epic wide shot of Vaigai valley merging into timeline of Tamil script evolution
panels.action: The Vaigai valley horizon blends into a stylized timeline showing cave inscriptions, coins, and later palm-leaf manuscripts, all flowing outward from the land.

dialogue.text: Keezhadi does not yet rewrite all dates. But it deepens the Sangam Age: an urban, literate society in the Vaigai valley, where history moves forward only as far as evidence walks.

i18n.hi: कीழड़ी अभी सारी तारीखें नहीं पलटती। पर वो सांगम युग को गहरा करती है — वैगई घाटी का शहरी, पढ़ा-लिखा समाज, जहाँ इतिहास उतना ही आगे बढ़ता है जितना सबूत साथ चलता है

panels.shot: extreme close-up of an inscribed sherd resting partly in soil, partly in light
panels.action: An inscribed sherd lies half-buried at the trench edge, one side still in the earth’s shadow, the letters catching the sun.

dialogue.text: Keezhadi teaches that good history must welcome new finds, yet walk slowly. Potsherds can speak of cities and letters, but only truthfully, layer by layer.

i18n.hi: कीழड़ी सिखाती है कि अच्छी इतिहास-लेखन नई खोजों का स्वागत करे, पर धीरे चले। मिट्टी के टुकड़े शहरों और अक्षरों की गवाही देते हैं, पर सच-सच — परत दर परत

title_i18n.hi: कीழड़ी में बोलती मिट्टी के टुकड़े

subtitle_i18n.en: Under the Red Earth, a Silent City Writes Its Name
subtitle_i18n.hi: लाल धरती के नीचे, एक खामोश शहर अपना नाम लिखता है
